about: Enemy playbook for the Isaac bot: a baseline of how each enemy behaves, so the bot starts with known behaviour instead of learning it by getting hit. See ENEMIES.md.
sources: floor lists: bindingofisaacrebirth.wiki.gg floor pages (Basement, Cellar, Burning Basement, Downpour, Dross; Caves, Catacombs, Flooded Caves, Mines, Ashpit partly)
behaviour: Isaac knowledge; anything not certain is in 'unsure'
bot_hits_logged: runs/hits.jsonl as of 2026-11-25 (tests + real play)
key_format: type.variant, same as hits.jsonl causes (e.g. '23.0'). Variants not listed: fall back to type.0 and treat as unsure.

movement.stationary: never moves (may still turn or shoot)
movement.wanders: drifts or walks at random, not toward Isaac
movement.chases: walks or floats straight toward Isaac
movement.hops: moves in short hops (airborne mid-hop, lands on a spot)
movement.jumps: long leaps that land at or near Isaac's spot
movement.bursts: sudden fast bursts in a random direction (spiders): position a moment later is a circle, not a line
movement.dashes_at_isaac: sudden fast dash toward Isaac's current spot
movement.charges_on_line: dashes in a straight line when Isaac lines up on its row or column
movement.burrows: goes underground (untouchable), surfaces near or under Isaac
movement.orbits: circles something (its parent, a boss, a point)
movement.tethered: on a cord or tied to a parent; can't go further than the cord allows
movement.bounces: flies diagonally and bounces off walls
movement.slides_on_line: slides fast along a row or column when Isaac lines up (Slide/Poky style)

attacks.shoots_single: fires one shot aimed at Isaac
attacks.shoots_spread: fires a fan of shots toward Isaac
attacks.shoots_ring: fires shots in fixed directions (plus, X or full ring), not aimed
attacks.shoots_burst: fires a cluster or volley of many shots at once (shotgun / random burst)
attacks.lobbed: arcing shots that land on a spot (shadow on the floor shows where)
attacks.stomp: lands on a spot from above (shadow shows where)
attacks.fire: is or leaves fire that hurts on touch
attacks.slam: melee wave/shockwave or ground slam around itself

defense.invulnerable_until: can't be hurt until something happens (opens, surfaces, lands)
defense.invulnerable: can never be killed by tears; avoid or ignore
defense.splits: turns into smaller enemies on death
defense.reforms: comes back after 'death' unless hit again (Globin puddle)
defense.shielded_front: blocks tears from the front; hit from behind/side
defense.phases: boss changes attacks at low health
defense.linked: shares health or behaviour with another part (twins, segments)
defense.speeds_up_when_hurt: gets faster as it loses health

scales.danger: 1 = harmless unless touched ... 5 = top threat for a no-hit bot
scales.kill_priority: 3 = kill first (spawners, homers, shooters, line-chargers), 2 = normal, 1 = whenever, 0 = can't or shouldn't (invulnerable, hazards)

non_enemy_hit_causes.0.8: spikes (floor hazard) - check against Isaac's edge, not centre
non_enemy_hit_causes.0.14: unsure: non-entity damage (curse room door / sacrifice spikes?)
non_enemy_hit_causes.0.0: no source: explosion (TNT, bomb), crushed etc.
non_enemy_hit_causes.2.0: Isaac's own tear (exploding tears like Fire Mind / Ipecac)

10.0.name: Gaper
10.0.how: Kite it in a circle and shoot; never let it pin you in a corner.

10.1.name: Frowning Gaper
10.1.how: Same as Gaper; it's a bit tougher, keep your distance.

10.2.name: Flaming Gaper
10.2.how: Same as Gaper but it leaves fires; don't walk where it walked.
10.2.unsure: variant id (10.2 vs 10.3) and how long its fire trail lasts

11.0.name: Gusher
11.0.how: Its blood shots go in random arcs: keep at medium range and don't stand near it.

11.1.name: Pacer
11.1.how: Harmless apart from touch; shoot it and don't walk into it.

12.0.name: Horf
12.0.how: Fires one shot when you're in range; never stand still on its line, sidestep after it shakes.

248.0.name: Psychic Horf
248.0.how: Its shot homes; shoot the shot or keep moving sideways, kill it early.

13.0.name: Fly
13.0.how: Slow and weak; shoot it when it comes close, don't chase it.

18.0.name: Attack Fly
18.0.how: Shoot it away, don't flee: it's faster than running and follows you into corners.

214.0.name: Level 2 Fly
214.0.how: Tougher black fly; shoot it from range.

249.0.name: Full Fly
249.0.how: Bursts into flies when killed: kill it from far away and be ready to shoot the flies.

256.0.name: Dart Fly
256.0.how: Pauses, then darts at you: sidestep at the pause, shoot it away, never be in a corner.

868.0.name: Army Fly
868.0.how: A fly with an orbiting escort; kill the escort flies from range then the core.

222.0.name: Ring of Flies
222.0.how: A ring of flies drifting at you; shoot into the ring from range, keep out of corners.

281.0.name: Swarm
281.0.how: A cloud of flies that follows you; back off in open space and keep shooting.

80.0.name: Moter
80.0.how: Splits into 2 Attack Flies when killed: kill it far away, then shoot the flies.

61.0.name: Sucker
61.0.how: Bursts into 4 shots (+ shape) when it dies: kill it at range, not on top of you.

61.1.name: Spit
61.1.how: Leaves creep where it dies: kill it away from where you need to walk.

61.5.name: Bulb
61.5.how: Touch drains your active item charge; shoot it before it reaches you.

14.0.name: Pooter
14.0.how: Fires one slow shot every so often; sidestep and shoot it.

14.1.name: Super Pooter
14.1.how: Fires a double shot; sidestep wider than for a Pooter.

15.0.name: Clotty
15.0.how: Fires 4 shots in a + every few hops: don't stand on its row or column.

15.1.name: Clot
15.1.how: Like Clotty but its shots are diagonal: stay off its diagonals.

15.2.name: I.Blob
15.2.how: Fires shots in 8 directions: stay at range and move between volleys.

15.3.name: Grilled Clotty
15.3.how: Burning Clotty: same + shots, keep off its lines.

16.0.name: Mulligan
16.0.how: Runs away and spawns flies; kill it early, it bursts into flies when killed.

16.1.name: Mulligoon
16.1.how: Explodes like a bomb when killed: kill it from more than 2 tiles away.

16.2.name: Mulliboom
16.2.how: Runs at you and explodes: shoot it early from range; never let it reach you.

16.3.name: Mullighoul
16.3.how: Spawns ghosts; kill it early from range.

205.0.name: Nest
205.0.how: Spawns spiders/Trites: kill it first, from range.

29.0.name: Hopper
29.0.how: Hops at random; harmless if you never stand where it lands. Shoot it.

29.1.name: Trite
29.1.how: Long leap at your spot: keep moving sideways after it crouches; shoot it while it sits.

54.0.name: Flaming Hopper
54.0.how: Hops randomly and can leave fire; don't stand where it lands.

217.0.name: Dip
217.0.how: Slides around fast but harmless; shoot it, don't walk into it.

217.3.name: Big Corn
217.3.how: Splits into smaller dips; kill from range.

220.0.name: Squirt
220.0.how: Dashes at you; splits into 2 Dips. Sidestep the dash and shoot.

208.0.name: Fatty
208.0.how: Slow but tanky; kite it in a loop, don't get trapped behind it in narrow rooms.

208.1.name: Pale Fatty
208.1.how: Like Fatty; can burst when it dies, kill it at range.

210.0.name: Blubber
210.0.how: Throws up a burst of shots: stay out of its face, side-on and at range.

257.0.name: Conjoined Fatty
257.0.how: Splits into a Fatty on death; slow, keep distance.

226.0.name: Skinny
226.0.how: Speeds up once hurt: finish it fast from range, keep a way out.

226.2.name: Crispy
226.2.how: Burning Skinny; finish it quickly, it speeds up.

244.0.name: Round Worm
244.0.how: Pops up and fires one shot: keep moving while it's underground, sidestep when it surfaces.

244.1.name: Tube Worm
244.1.how: Pops up and lobs a shot: watch the landing shadow, keep moving.

255.0.name: Night Crawler
255.0.how: Only hittable when up: keep moving, never stand still while it's under.

85.0.name: Spider
85.0.how: Moves in sudden random bursts: treat its reach as a circle, shoot it from 3+ tiles.

94.0.name: Big Spider
94.0.how: Bigger bursts; splits into 2 Spiders. Shoot from range.

215.0.name: Level 2 Spider
215.0.how: Red spider that leaves creep; shoot from range and avoid its trail.

250.0.name: Ticking Spider
250.0.how: Hops at you and explodes: shoot it before it's close, back away from it.

206.0.name: Baby Long Legs
206.0.how: Lays Sacks/spiders; kill it fast, kill the spiders it makes.

207.0.name: Crazy Long Legs
207.0.how: Winds up then stomps where you stand: move off the spot when it rears up; kill spawns.

207.1.name: Small Crazy Long Legs
207.1.how: Same as Crazy Long Legs, smaller.

231.0.name: Nerve Ending
231.0.how: Doesn't move; just don't walk into it.

240.0.name: Wall Creep
240.0.how: Crawls on a wall and fires when lined up with you: don't stand in front of it.

242.0.name: Blind Creep
242.0.how: Wall crawler that shoots along its line; stay off its line.

218.0.name: Wall Hugger
218.0.how: Can't be killed; it slides along the walls, so keep off the edge of the room.

44.1.name: Slide
44.1.how: Can't be killed; it slides when you line up with it, so don't stay on its row/column.

284.0.name: Cyclopia
284.0.how: Fires aimed shots; keep moving across its line.

276.0.name: Roundy
276.0.how: Jumps around and sprays shots when it lands: keep away from its landing spot and lines.

282.0.name: Mega Clotty
282.0.how: Big Clotty: bigger + volleys, splits into Clotties; stay far off its lines.

289.0.name: Ulcer
289.0.how: Pops up, fires and spawns flies; kill it when it appears.

302.0.name: Stoney
302.0.how: Can't be killed; walks after you. Keep moving and clear the room around it.

305.0.name: Ministro
305.0.how: Hops toward you; shoot it before it lands near you.

306.0.name: Portal
306.0.how: Spawns enemies until killed: kill it first.

291.1.name: Suction Pitfall
291.1.how: Pulls you in: stay away from it.

299.0.name: Greed Gaper
299.0.how: Steals coins on touch; kite and shoot like a Gaper.

246.1.name: Rag Man's Ragling
246.1.how: Becomes a pile after 'death' that revives: kill it, then keep shooting the pile.

246.0.name: Ragling
246.0.how: Falls into a pile and gets up again; shoot the pile too.

279.0.name: Black Globin's Head
279.0.how: Fast head; shoot it while kiting.

869.0.name: Migraine
869.0.how: Unsure; keep at range and off its lines.

884.0.name: Swarm Spider
884.0.how: Comes in swarms of fast spiders: back into open space and spray.

881.0.name: Needle
881.0.how: Pokes up from the ground where you are: keep moving.

76.0.name: Blastocyst (small)
76.0.how: Hops toward you; shoot it before it lands near.

96.0.name: Eternal Fly
96.0.how: Orbits its host; can't die while it's alive, kill the host and dodge the orbit.

25.0.name: Boom Fly
25.0.how: Bounces diagonally and explodes when killed: kill it while it's far away.

33.0.name: Fire (Fireplace)
33.0.how: Don't touch; shoot it out if it blocks the way.

33.1.name: Red Fire
33.1.how: Shoots at you: put it out early from range or keep off its line.

292.0.name: Movable TNT
292.0.how: Explodes when shot: don't shoot it while close; never stand next to it.

806.0.name: Bubbles
806.0.how: Splits into smaller bubbles; shoot from range.

807.0.name: Wraith
807.0.how: Fades in and out; only hittable when visible. Keep moving.

808.0.name: Willo
808.0.how: Darts at you: shoot it away, sidestep.

810.0.name: Small Leech
810.0.how: Fast little leech: shoot it before it's close.

812.0.name: Sub Horf
812.0.how: Surfaces and fires; sidestep when it rises.

813.0.name: Blurb
813.0.how: Sprays shots; keep at range off its lines.

879.0.name: Bloaty
879.0.how: Bursts when killed; kill at range.

870.0.name: Drip
870.0.how: Small and weak; shoot it, avoid its creep.

871.0.name: Splurt
871.0.how: Pops into shots/poop when killed; kill from range.

873.0.name: Fly Trap
873.0.how: Unsure; kill it first from range.

874.0.name: Gas Dwarf
874.0.how: Unsure: leaves gas clouds; keep away from them.

875.0.name: Poot Mine
875.0.how: Mine: blows up when touched or shot; don't stand near it.

20.0.name: Monstro
20.0.how: Big jump lands where you were: run when it leaves the ground; dodge sideways from its spit burst.

19.0.name: Larry Jr.
19.0.how: Worm segments: stay out of its path, don't get boxed in by its body.

79.0.name: Gemini
79.0.how: Big twin chases; baby on a cord swings around it. Circle the room centre, never a corner.

79.1.name: Steven
79.1.how: Like Gemini; the small one shoots. Circle in open space.

79.2.name: Blighted Ovum
79.2.how: Gemini-like with shots; circle the room centre and dodge sideways.

79.10.name: Gemini baby (Suture)
79.10.how: Can't go further than its cord from the big twin: stay out of that circle.

79.11.name: Steven baby
79.11.how: Tied to big Steven; keep out of its cord circle.

79.12.name: Blighted Ovum baby
79.12.how: Tied to the Ovum; keep out of its cord circle.

99.0.name: Gurdy Jr.
99.0.how: Dashes along rows/columns: never line up with it; kill its flies.

67.0.name: The Duke of Flies
67.0.how: Spawns and blows out flies: keep killing the flies, stay out of corners.

261.0.name: Dingle

261.1.name: Dangle
261.1.how: Like Dingle but faster; step off its line early.

100.0.name: Widow

62.0.name: Pin

62.3.name: Wormwood

260.0.name: The Haunt

260.0.note: wiki: not in Repentance on Burning Basement; still in Cellar

260.10.name: Lil Haunt
260.10.how: Shoot them as they come; keep moving, don't stand still.

63.0.name: Famine
63.0.how: Charges across the room: stay off its line; it gets wild at low health.

81.0.name: The Fallen

82.0.name: Headless Horseman (body)

83.0.name: Headless Horseman (head)

237.1.name: Gurglings (boss)

404.0.name: Little Horn

405.0.name: Rag Man

908.0.name: Baby Plum

902.0.name: The Rainmaker

914.0.name: Clog
914.0.how: Lobs gunk; keep moving, watch shadows.

917.0.name: Colostomia
917.0.how: Jumps; move when it leaves the ground.

46.0.name: Sloth

46.0.unsure: shot path (bot predicted danger 0 before hits: maybe arcs/curves)

47.0.name: Lust

48.0.name: Wrath
48.0.how: Drops bombs: keep away from bombs, never stand next to it.

49.0.name: Gluttony
49.0.how: Fires a beam along its line: stay off its row/column, keep moving.

50.0.name: Greed
50.0.how: Takes coins and fires spreads; dodge sideways at range.

51.0.name: Envy
51.0.how: Splits into many bouncing heads: shoot from mid-room, watch bounces.

81.1.name: Krampus
81.1.how: Devil-room fight: stay off its row/column (brimstone).

23.0.name: Charger

23.0.note: also spawned by Sloth on floor 1-2

23.1.name: Drowned Charger
23.1.how: Stay off its lines; kill at range (shots on death).

22.1.name: Drowned Hive
22.1.how: Spawns Drowned Chargers: kill it first.

25.2.name: Drowned Boom Fly
25.2.how: Bursts into shots when killed; kill it far away.

30.0.name: Boil
30.0.how: Grows then fires; kill it while small.

277.0.name: Black Bony
277.0.how: Explodes on death; kill at range.

24.0.name: Globin
24.0.how: Turns into a puddle that revives: keep shooting the puddle.

27.0.name: Host

27.1.name: Red Host
27.1.how: Bigger shotgun: bait from far away.

204.0.name: Mobile Host
204.0.how: Host that walks; bait it from range.

41.0.name: Knight
41.0.how: Only hittable from behind: get beside or behind it.

31.0.name: Spitty
31.0.how: Shoots when you line up: stay off its lines.

243.0.name: Conjoined Spitty
243.0.how: Two-way shooter; stay off its lines.

26.0.name: Maw
26.0.how: Floats at you and shoots; sidestep.

26.1.name: Red Maw

26.2.name: Psychic Maw
26.2.how: Homing shots; keep moving, shoot it early.

35.0.name: Mr. Maw
35.0.how: Head on a neck; kill the head.

34.0.name: Leaper
34.0.how: Jumps on your spot: move when it leaves the ground.

87.0.name: Gurgle
87.0.how: Leaves creep; kite in loops not crossing the trail.

258.0.name: Fat Bat
258.0.how: Bursts into shots; kill it at range.

229.0.name: Tumor
229.0.how: Fires spreads; stay off its lines.

42.0.name: Stone Grimace
42.0.how: Can't be killed; shoots along its line: never stand in front of it.

202.0.name: Constant Stone Shooter
202.0.how: Never stand on its firing line.

300.0.name: Mushroom
300.0.how: Pops up and sprays; keep moving.

304.0.name: The Thing

819.0.name: Fly Bomb
819.0.how: Shoot it before it reaches you.

822.0.name: Bouncer

818.0.name: Rock Spider

818.1.name: Coal Spider

889.0.name: Clickety Clack
889.0.how: Collapses and gets up; keep shooting.

28.0.name: Chub

28.2.name: Carrion Queen

36.0.name: Gurdy

264.0.name: Mega Fatty
264.0.how: Big jumps and vomit; move on lift-off.

269.0.name: Polycephalus

19.1.name: The Hollow

19.2.name: Tuff Twins
19.2.how: Worms; stay out of their path.

907.0.name: Great Gideon

906.0.name: Hornfel

46.1.name: Super Sloth
